sections.appearance: She has long silver hair tied with black bows in twin tails with bangs covering her left eye. She has bright red eyes, light brown skin, elven ears, and a black devil’s tail. Halo ==== Iori's halo is grey colored with two circles; the smaller one is crossed with three points in a triangular pattern, forming a crosshair. Uniform ==== She wears a white collared uniform shirt with black and white striped cuffs, a black tie with two white chevrons pointing downwards, a gold pin on her left chest, and a red military armband around her left sleeve. She further wears a black corset with four gold buttons, a pair of black and red gloves, a short flowing skirt with knee-high black stockings, and black high-heeled boots. Firearm ==== thumb|Crack Shot|150px She uses a Karabiner 98k bolt-action battle rifle with a spiked cheek rest.
